36: pub fn decoding_key_from_secret(

39: ) -> JWTResult<DecodingKey<'static>> {

41:         Algorithm::HS256 | Algorithm::HS384 | Algorithm::HS512 => {
42:             if secret_string.starts_with('@') {

52:             } else {
53:                 Ok(DecodingKey::from_secret(secret_string.as_bytes()).into_static())
54:             }
55:         }
56:         Algorithm::RS256
57:         | Algorithm::RS384
58:         | Algorithm::RS512
59:         | Algorithm::PS256
60:         | Algorithm::PS384
61:         | Algorithm::PS512 => {
62:             let secret = slurp_file(&secret_string.chars().skip(1).collect::<String>());

64:             match secret_string.ends_with(".pem") {
65:                 true => DecodingKey::from_rsa_pem(&secret).map(DecodingKey::into_static),
66:                 false => Ok(DecodingKey::from_rsa_der(&secret).into_static()),
67:             }
68:         }
